# LeadKart CRM (LeadFlow Pro) — Multi-Tenant B2B Sales & Revenue Suite

> LeadKart CRM is an enterprise-grade multi-tenant B2B Sales Management and Revenue Operations Platform. It powers end-to-end sales cycles: from instant public QR lead capture forms to weighted Postgres Kanban pipelines, automated Google Meet follow-ups, itemized CPQ quotations, and automated invoice balance reconciliations.

## System Architecture & Security
- **Frontend Stack**: TanStack Start (Nitro SSR), TanStack Router, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4 (OKLCH color system), Radix UI primitives.
- **Database Engine**: Neon Serverless PostgreSQL with PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) strictly enforced across all tenant tables.
- **Data Isolation**: Multi-tenant isolation at the database layer ensuring zero cross-tenant query leaks.
- **Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)**: 5 granular roles: Owner, Admin, Sales Manager, Sales Executive, Accountant, mapped to 38+ system permissions.
- **Data Sync**: TanStack Query v5 with optimistic UI updates and real-time cache invalidation.

## Core Functional Modules
1. **Lead Capture & Public Form Builder (`/forms` & `/f/:slug`)**:
   - Dynamic form builder with custom input fields (Name, Email, Phone, Company, Budget, Industry, Project Details).
   - Instant printable high-res QR code generator and shareable public URLs.
   - Submissions automatically ingest into tenant lead queues with auto-assignment.

2. **Sales Pipeline & Deal Forecasting (`/pipeline`)**:
   - Visual Kanban board with stage progression (Discovery, Demo Scheduled, Proposal Sent, Negotiation, Closed Won).
   - Real-time probability multipliers calculated directly in PostgreSQL for accurate weighted revenue forecasts.

3. **Follow-Up Automation & Meeting Detection (`/follow-ups` & `/demos`)**:
   - Task management for calls, emails, and presentations with overdue alerts.
   - Regex-based automated parsing of Google Meet, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams meeting URLs.
   - Demo outcomes logging and timeline integration.

4. **Product Catalog & CPQ Quotations (`/products` & `/quotations`)**:
   - Reusable inventory of items and services with SKUs, category tags, and unit pricing.
   - Itemized quotation builder supporting line discounts, GST/tax calculations, terms, and printable PDF previews.

5. **Invoices & Payment Reconciliation (`/invoices`)**:
   - 1-click conversion from approved quotations into milestone or full invoices.
   - Partial payment recording with remaining balance formulas and automated status transitions (Draft, Sent, Paid, Overdue).

6. **Executive Dashboard (`/dashboard`)**:
   - Live revenue metrics, won deal volumes, active pipeline, qualified lead counters, and unified activity feed.
